_comment: Municipal regulatory frameworks ONLY — what each bylaw requires. Never record live applications or named proponents here. Fields left null mean 'not yet verified', which the UI renders as 'Needs research' rather than guessing. Add or correct a row via the 'Add a municipality' issue form.

municipalities.name: Parkland County

useClass.detail: 'Computer, Electronic, Data Processing Services' is a permitted land use on quarter sections following the Land Use Bylaw 2017-18 text amendments.

district.detail: Council approved amendments on 4 September 2025 creating new Direct Control Districts alongside Highvale End Area Structure Plan amendments.

secondaryPlan.detail: A Master Site Development Plan (MSDP) is required in addition to a Development Permit for data processing facility development on the amended lands.

reporting.detail: No standing public reporting obligation identified in the bylaw text reviewed.

municipalities.regulations: Section 5.80 — Data Processing Facility Regulations, Land Use Bylaw 2017-18
municipalities.notes: Council approved the Highvale End ASP amendments, the Land Use Bylaw amendments, the new Direct Control Districts, and Section 5.80 Data Processing Facility Regulations on 4 September 2025.

municipalities.name: Rocky View County

useClass.detail: Bylaw C-8766-2026, approved 21 July 2026, changed Data Centre Campus from a permitted use to a discretionary use.

district.detail: The Special, Data Centre District, commonly identified as S-DAT.

municipalities.notes: The discretionary designation gives the development authority latitude to assess a proposal on its merits and to refuse a development permit on planning considerations and community impacts. Council approved the bylaw following a public hearing.
municipalities.sourceName: Rocky View County — Land Use Bylaw

municipalities.name: Sturgeon County

useClass.detail: Council amended Bylaw 1385-17 (Land Use Bylaw) in April 2022 to add Data Processing Facilities as a permitted use with associated regulations.

district.detail: Projects are expected to locate in pre-zoned industrial areas — Alberta's Industrial Heartland and Sturgeon Industrial Park.

reporting.detail: Operators are expected to report publicly each year on water use, noise levels, and nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions.

costRecovery.detail: Developers must fund all project-related infrastructure improvements. Costs cannot be transferred to municipal ratepayers.

municipalities.notes: The clearest cost-recovery and ongoing-reporting language of the Alberta municipalities reviewed. Useful as a drafting benchmark.

municipalities.name: MD of Greenview No. 16

useClass.detail: No data-centre-specific use class identified in the material reviewed. General development permit requirements apply.

secondaryPlan.detail: A development permit is required prior to any development taking place.

municipalities.regulations: Greenview Land Use Bylaw — general setbacks: 40 m from a property line adjacent to a road or undeveloped road allowance; 15 m from any other property line; 7.5 m from a service road.
municipalities.notes: General development permit framework rather than a data-centre-specific regime.
